terra.problem: The line combines two places called Meribah: Israel tested the LORD at Meribah near Rephidim, while Moses and Aaron rebelled at the waters of Meribah in Kadesh. It should distinguish them.
“Israel tests the LORD” says the LORD gave Moses the instruction at the rock, but Exodus 17:6–7 does not say where Moses was when he received it.
“Aaron will not enter the land” takes place at Mount Hor, not Meribah. The LORD refers back to what happened at Meribah.
“Moses told he will die too” refers back to Meribah; it does not take place there. The surrounding passage locates Moses on a mountain in the Abarim range.
